ios.desc:
Whether you’re just starting out or chasing big goals, wanting to get active or lose weight, Pacer’s insightful data, outdoor routes, and personalized plans help you move more, feel great, and stay on track—like your 24/7 walking buddy. Join over 12 million happy walkers and find motivation every step of the way.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE PACER

- Effortless Activity Tracking
    Tracks steps, flights climbed, calories burned, distance, and active time—whether your phone is in your hand, pocket, or bag. Syncs with Apple Health and Apple Watch for seamless data.
- Motivation & Community Support
    Join walking groups, compete in friendly challenges, and share progress with friends and family in real time—no matter what phone they use.
- Explore Outdoors with GPS Mapping
    Explore local gems—routes, trails, and parks. Record every walk, hike, run, or ride with precision maps.
- Personalized Fitness Plans & Weight Management
    Set daily goals, track your weight and BMI, and use guided workouts designed to help you lose weight and get fit.
- Simple Setup, No Extra Devices Needed
    Just download and start—no wristbands or hardware required.
    
HEAR FROM OUR HAPPY WALKERS:

- “Best Walking App. Period. I love this app and use it for every walk.” — James T.
- “I'm 73 and I especially like that if I start an activity and want my kids to be able to monitor where I am I can turn live tracking on in Pacer.” — Dr J.
- “…Tracks all progress and more! Love the challenges and clubs to join all while sharing and interacting with others all the hard earned work. Definitely recommend.” — Lustine K.
- “Cheaper and better than a gym membership and 1000x more effective!” — Covette92

READY TO TAKE THE FIRST STEP?

Download Pacer for free today and start your journey to better health with the happiest walking community!

Note:

quotes.text:
You can actually easily incorporate activities in your daily routines. Get a standing desk, do some quick stretches/body-weight exercise after 40 min of coding, march/bike in place while watching videos/TV, stroll afer meals, etc.

Getting a pedometer app also helps. If you're self-monitoring your activity level, there's a great chance you'll try to improve it (consciously or unconsciously).[1]

Allow me to advertise our app: Pacer Pedometer[2]. It comes with activity tracking, fun virtual activity challenges, healthy lifestyle lessons, guided body-weight exercise etc. We also have a corporate plan in which you can join challenges with your colleagues.

[1] Kang, Minsoo, et al. "Effect of pedometer-based physical activity interventions: a meta-analysis." Research quarterly for exercise and sport 80.3 (2009): 648-655.
[2] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pacer-pedometer-step-tracker/id600446812
